Deploy to your github.io

30-Second Zero-Config Host Guide

Step 1: Create GitHub Repo

Create a repository named <your-username>.github.io on your GitHub account.

Step 2: Save as index.html

Upload this file into your repo as index.html (it's 100% self-contained!).

Step 3: Enable Pages & Add to LinkedIn

Under Repo Settings → Pages, select Deploy from a branch (main / root). Copy your URL and paste it into your LinkedIn Featured section!

How to Feature on LinkedIn

Add this site to your LinkedIn Featured section

1 Tap "Add section" on your Profile

Open your LinkedIn profile (right where you see the blue "Open to" button in your screenshot), and tap the "Add section" button next to it.

2 Choose Recommended → Add featured

Select "Recommended", then tap "Add featured".

3 Tap "+" and choose "Add a link"

Paste your hosted GitHub URL: https://<your-username>.github.io

4 Recommended Title & Description
